title: Chinese Adventures in China (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
Arthur is a bored millionaire, engaged to Alice. On a cruise to Hong Kong, his friend Mr Goh comes up with a solution: he convinces Arthur to take out a two-million-dollar life insurance policy expiring in one month, and tells Arthur that he may be killed at any moment. Determined
to survive, Arthur fights for his life, accompanied by his butler Léon and Alexandrine, a young woman he met in Hong Kong.

synopsis_lang.en:
Arthur is a bored millionaire, engaged to Alice. On a cruise to Hong Kong, his friend Mr Goh comes up with a solution: he convinces Arthur to take out a two-million-dollar life insurance policy expiring in one month, and tells Arthur that he may be killed at any moment. Determined
to survive, Arthur fights for his life, accompanied by his butler Léon and Alexandrine, a young woman he met in Hong Kong.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Arthur是個生活無聊的百萬富翁，與Alice訂了婚。在前往香港的郵輪上，他的朋友Mr. Goh想出一個辦法: 說服Arthur購買一份二百萬美元的人壽保險，保單一個月後到期，並告訴Arthur他隨時可能被殺。Arthur決心活下去，於是夥同管家Léon和他在香港認識的年輕女子Alexandrine，展開一場激烈的求生搏鬥。
